rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ 'Dielectric constant is same as permittivity' ✅ Dielectric constant (relative permittivity) is a ratio (dimensionless), while permittivity has specific units (F/m).  ·  ❌ 'Dielectrics conduct electricity like metals' ✅ Dielectrics are insulators; they polarize in an electric field but do not conduct free charges like conductors.
